Speaker: Mira
Text: Excuse me — you're the one who activated Ashcroft's prototype, aren't you?

Speaker: Kael
Text: Word travels fast. Who are you?

Speaker: Mira
Text: Mira. Cogspire graduate, starlight mage. I've been studying the Rift since it opened. I want to help.

Speaker: Kael
Text: This isn't a research expedition. It's a rescue mission.

Speaker: Mira
Text: I know. My mentor was taken too. We have the same goal, Kael. Let me come with you.
